title: Isolate CI jobs from inherited compiler wrappers
objective: Correct the observed missing-sccache wrapper failure using job-local environment overrides.
acceptance: CI job environments explicitly clear RUSTC_WRAPPER and RUSTC_WORKSPACE_WRAPPER without modifying host settings or installing wrappers.
Preserve all runner trust, bootstrap checksum, pinned/offline toolchain and existing test gates.
Negative fixtures reject absent or nonempty compiler-wrapper overrides; a bounded probe demonstrates missing-wrapper failure and cleared-wrapper success.
Focused and authoritative full checks pass locally; document run 40211448552 without claiming unobserved Linux success.
non_goals: Product changes, dependency installation, host configuration changes or edits to the frozen S02 evidence envelope.
